title: Concurrent posting for General Ledger entries
summary: Adds concurrent posting support for General Ledger entries. The change touches G/L posting codeunits, ledger entry and register tables, document posting codeunits, and related reports across many localization layers; the PR description gives no further detail.
key_points: Title states concurrent posting for General Ledger entries; description has no details
Modifies Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Gen. Jnl.-Post Batch and Gen. Jnl.-Post Reverse
Touches G/L Entry, G/L Register, VAT Entry, bank, detailed customer/vendor/employee and FA ledger tables
Sales, purchase, service, transfer and assembly posting codeunits and several register and date compress reports are also changed
Applied across many localization layers (210 files)
